services.desc: Payments can be made in the form of a check, cash, Visa, MasterCard, Discover, or American Express. A deposit of 50% is required to reserve your fishing charter, with the remaining balance due upon the completion of the trip. See Cancellation Policy below. Half Day Newport Fishing Charters - 8:00 a.m. - 12:00 p.m. or 1:00 p.m. - 5:00 p.m. Come ‘Tog fishing with experts using our new Minn Kota Instinct trolling motor (“spot lock”) with auto stow and deploy. This increased accuracy keeps us on the hot spot so you can reel in more! For sailing regattas, race boat committees, photography excursions, music festivals, sea diving, etc… We can accommodate up to six people. ($600 minimum reservation

blurb: Sara Star Fishing Charters offers fishing trips tailored to guests' preferences along Rhode Island's coastline. The captains are Coast Guard licensed and provide all necessary gear, bait, and refreshments. Guests only need to reel in the fish and enjoy the experience.
extraNote: Stripers over 35 inches must be released for conservation · 128 Long Wharf, Newport, RI
